description:
The C2L Diwali Celebrations was held on 3rd November from 5.30 pm to 9 pm at Yashwant Bhavan, Lower Parel
The program began with snacks and tea, welcome, address by President & Mentors, talent show by kids, musical show and bhajans, group games and activities, inspirational success stories by C2L students, experience sharing and testimonials by Gurukul Hostel Mentees and students with special achievements, gift distribution and followed by dinner.
With around 86 mentees who joined us, it was a beautiful opportunity to share happiness, celebrate their talents and achievements, and create joyful memories together.
Generous contributions -
1. Snacks & dinner sponsored - Rtn PP Jagdish & Reshma Tanna
2. ⁠Rs 500 per child - Rtn Vivek & Meghna Khetan
3.Sweet boxes- Ajay & Mona Shah
4. Books & stationery - Rtn Devang & Falguni Mehta
5. Personalised stainless steel sipper bottle - Rtn Manoj & Minaxi Laddha
6. Rtn Vipul Shah
Project cost Rs 3 lakhs
Attended 7 Rotarians, 3 Partners, 3 children
